title: 第七章 最终成绩

content_zh:
熙熙攘攘的考生们都出了考场。
2056年江南市高考，正式结束。
下面考生们需要做的就是等待一个星期后的高考查分了。
“昊白。”略微秃顶，看似儒雅的中年男人站在校门口，笑着朝走出考场门外的儿子喊道。
“爸。”张昊白笑着走过去。
“考的怎么样？”中年男人笑道。
张昊白摇摇头，无奈道：“这次发挥的只能说还行，不过数学题还真难，从选择题、填空题，到计算题，难题很多。特别是计算题……五道计算题，我只是作出两道来。其他三道题目，我只能尽量作出部分，按步骤给分，应该也能给我一些分。”
数学五道大题目，考验的思维，自然是按照步骤给分。
“哦？”张昊白的父亲张泽龙皱眉道，“看来，这次数学你的分数，会比较低啊。”
“没事的。爸。难，是所有考生都难。也不是我一个。”张昊白笑道，“数学题目比较难，最后的本科线肯定要比较低一点。我考进军校，应该没问题。”
“哦，对了。”
张泽龙一笑道，“之前，我们在校门口等你们考试结束，中途知道一个事情。你们学校那个名气很大的叫‘罗峰’的考生，在考试中途，距离考试结束还有一个小时左右，竟然晕倒在了考场。”
“晕倒在了考场？”张昊白瞪大眼睛，“爸，你是说罗峰？”
“对啊，那罗峰被救护车带走，很多人都看到了。”张泽龙点头道，“你听，周围很多家长在和子女说这个事呢。”
“罗峰晕倒？”
张昊白连看向周围，耳朵也仔细竖起来听，果然有大量家长和子女谈论到有一个考生在考场晕倒昏迷的事，张昊白清晰听到不少人议论‘罗峰’。
“哈哈，这个穷小子，也有这一天。哈哈。”张昊白忍不住大笑起来。
“爸，你是不知道，这个家伙在学校的时候，经常找我麻烦。”张昊白气愤连道，“仗着实力比我强，事事都压我一头。这个家伙，也有这一天。”张昊白心中畅快万分，他对罗峰可谓是怨气大到极点。
实际上罗峰从来都不理会这张昊白，只是张昊白自己一直将罗峰当成对手，罗峰在文化成绩、武力上都超越他，自然让他难受的很。
“哈哈，这种小家伙，没见过世面。心理压力大，承受不了就崩溃了。别管他了。走，你叔知道你今天高考结束，亲自为你定了酒席。快走吧。”张泽龙笑道。

“叔？”张昊白眼睛一亮。
他们张家之所以能够在宜安区算是富甲一方，就是因为他叔，因为……
他叔，是武者！
※※※※※
“不可能，绝对不可能！”
刚从考场出来的魏文，在自己爸妈面前，一下子就急了，“阿峰他怎么可能在考场晕，他紧张的昏迷？不可能。别的不说，阿峰的心理素质，就算在极限武馆当中，也是被教员老师点名夸赞的。”
魏文和罗峰，可以说不是亲兄弟，胜似亲兄弟。
“阿文啊，这还有假？这是我们亲眼看到的。那罗峰他爸还有他那坐着轮椅的弟弟，当时就急得一起去医院了。”魏文父亲连说道。
“医院？应该是最近的医院。爸，妈，我先去看罗峰，午饭等会儿去吃。”
说着顾不得那么多，魏文就将考试文具给了爸妈，连朝医院跑去。
宜安区人民医院内。
罗峰正挤出笑容陪着父亲、弟弟从医院大厅厅门口走了出来，这时候罗洪国和罗华，都有些担心罗峰遭受打击太大。
“爸，我没事，走，我们回去吃饭。”罗峰一副很坦然的样子，虽然心中有些不甘心，可是罗峰却知道，事情已经发生了无法更改，能做的只能是接受！
“阿峰，阿峰。”远处传来声音。
罗峰抬头看去，只见远处一道人影正朝医院大门口跑来，正是自己的好兄弟‘魏文’。
看到急匆匆跑过来，衣服都汗湿的魏文，罗峰有些感动，随即心中一动，连问道：“阿文，这数学试卷的最后三道计算题难度怎么样？”自己根本没来得及做最后三题，如果最后三题难度非常大，让绝大多数人都做不出多少的话。

content_en:
The bustling candidates all left the examination room.
In 2056, the Jiangnan City College Entrance Examination officially ended.
All the candidates need to do next is to wait for the college entrance examination score test in one week.
"Hao Bai." A slightly bald, elegant-looking middle-aged man stood at the school gate and shouted to his son who was walking out of the examination room with a smile.
"Dad." Zhang Haobai walked over with a smile.
"How did you go in the exam?" the middle-aged man smiled.
Zhang Haobai shook his head and said helplessly: "My performance this time can only be said to be okay, but the math questions are really difficult. From multiple-choice questions, fill-in-the-blank questions, to calculation questions, there are many difficult problems. Especially the calculation questions... I only solved two of the five calculation questions. For the other three questions, I can only try to solve parts as much as possible, and give points according to the steps. It should be able to give me some points."
The five major questions in mathematics test the thinking, and points are naturally given according to the steps.
"Oh?" Zhang Haobai's father, Zhang Zelong, frowned, "It seems that your score in mathematics this time will be relatively low."
"It's okay, Dad. It's difficult for all candidates. I'm not the only one." Zhang Haobai said with a smile, "The math questions are more difficult, and the final undergraduate score will definitely be lower. I should be fine if I get into the military school."
"Oh, right."
Zhang Zelong smiled and said, "Before, we were waiting for your exam to end at the school gate, and we learned something halfway. The famous candidate in your school named 'Luo Feng' actually fainted in the exam room in the middle of the exam, about an hour before the end of the exam."
"Fainted in the examination room?" Zhang Haobai's eyes widened, "Dad, you mean Luo Feng?"
"Yes, Luo Feng was taken away in an ambulance, and many people saw it." Zhang Zelong nodded, "Listen, many parents around are talking to their children about this."
"Luo Feng fainted?"
Zhang Haobai looked around and listened carefully. As expected, a large number of parents and children talked about a candidate who fainted in the examination room. Zhang Haobai clearly heard many people talking about 'Luo Feng'.
"Haha, this poor boy also has this day. Haha." Zhang Haobai couldn't help laughing.
"Dad, you don't know, this guy often made trouble for me when he was in school." Zhang Haobai said angrily, "Because he is stronger than me, he dominates me in everything. This guy will also have this day." Zhang Haobai felt very happy in his heart, and he was extremely resentful towards Luo Feng.
In fact, Luo Feng never paid attention to Zhang Haobai, but Zhang Haobai himself always regarded Luo Feng as his opponent. Luo Feng surpassed him in terms of cultural achievements and military force, which naturally made him feel very uncomfortable.
"Haha, this little guy has never seen the world. He is under great psychological pressure and will collapse when he can't bear it. Leave him alone. Let's go. Your uncle knows that you are finishing the college entrance examination today and has personally ordered a banquet for you. Come on," Zhang Zelong said with a smile.
"Uncle?" Zhang Haobai's eyes lit up.
The reason why the Zhang family is considered one of the richest in Yi'an District is because of his uncle, because...
His uncle is a warrior!
※※※※※
"Impossible, absolutely impossible!"
Wei Wen, who had just come out of the examination room, suddenly became anxious in front of his parents, "How could Ah Feng faint in the examination room? He was so nervous that he passed out? Impossible. Apart from anything else, Ah Feng's psychological quality is praised by the teachers even in the extreme martial arts gym."
Wei Wen and Luo Feng can be said to be more than real brothers.
"Awen, is this fake? We saw this with our own eyes. Luo Feng's father and his brother in a wheelchair were so anxious that they went to the hospital together." Wei Wen's father said continuously.
"Hospital? It should be the nearest hospital. Dad, Mom, I'm going to see Luo Feng first, and I'll have lunch later."
Saying that he didn't care so much, Wei Wen gave the exam stationery to his parents and ran towards the hospital.
Inside Yi'an District People's Hospital.
Luo Feng was forcing out a smile to accompany his father and younger brother from the hospital.Walking out of the hall door, Luo Hongguo and Luo Hua were both worried that Luo Feng would be hit too hard.
"Dad, I'm fine, let's go back and eat." Luo Feng looked very calm. Although he was a little unwilling, Luo Feng knew that things had happened and could not be changed. All he could do was accept it!
"A Feng, A Feng." A voice came from afar.
Luo Feng looked up and saw a figure in the distance running towards the hospital gate. It was his good brother 'Wei Wen'.
Seeing Wei Wen running over in a hurry, his clothes soaked with sweat, Luo Feng was a little moved, and then his heart moved, and he asked: "Awen, how difficult are the last three calculation questions in this math paper?" He didn't have time to do the last three questions. If the last three questions were so difficult that most people couldn't do much.
